carousel.excerpt: Moneycontrol reporting says the US asset manager is in advanced discussions over about 20% of the IPL franchise from the Mehta Group, at a valuation of over $1.8 billion — with no final agreement reached.
carousel.image_caption: The Eden Gardens stadium just before the beginning of the Indian Premier League match between the Kolkata Knight Riders and the Chennai Super Kings, on the 18th of May, 2008. US alternative asset manager Ares Management is reportedly in talks to acquire a minority stake in Kolkata Knight Riders, according to Moneycontrol reporting cited in fresh reports this week — no final agreement has been reached.
carousel.image_credit: Photo: Partha Bhaumik via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0)
carousel.nri_angle: KKR's owner group also runs the Los Angeles Knight Riders in Major League Cricket, so a US institutional buyer for the IPL franchise would deepen the Knight Riders brand's American footprint.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: After Jensen Huang: What Founder Exits Did to Apple, Alphabet and Uber
carousel.excerpt: Nvidia's co-founder resigned with no named successor and no reason given. The record of Apple, Alphabet, Uber and Twitter shows preparation — not the founder's genius — decides what happens next.
carousel.image_caption: File photograph of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang. Huang resigned as president, chief executive and board member on November 12, 2026, and Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is serving as interim chief executive.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers and investors are heavily represented at Nvidia and across the U.S. AI sector, making the succession outcome a direct workplace and portfolio story for the diaspora.

carousel.title: Carney Says Canada and US Making Progress Toward Trade Deal, No Agreement Yet
carousel.excerpt: Speaking in Manila, Carney described a long call with President Trump and said a bilateral deal is possible — but Ottawa will not accept terms inconsistent with a viable Canadian auto sector.
carousel.image_caption: The flag of Canada. Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada and the United States are making progress toward a trade deal, with no agreement yet reached.
